issue_request: FHIR-12230 was Published/Persuasive for DSTU2 Coverage and requested adding RelatedPerson as a choice for PlanHolder/planholderReference because a person may be the plan holder without being a patient at the treating practice.

Later Coverage source refactors preserved those target profiles in structuredefinition-Coverage.xml.
additional_context: FHIR-12067 explains the PlanHolder rename/split into subscriber and policyHolder concepts, while FHIR-7772 records the related decision that Person is not a direct Coverage participant and RelatedPerson was added. A 2016 Zulip implementers thread discusses the same non-patient planholder use case. Exact-key Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting later evidence.
